name: Introduction and Interview
description: General questions about familiar, everyday topics.

questions.text: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Is your hometown a good place for young people?
Would you like to live in your hometown in the future?
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favourite room in your home?
Is there anything you would like to change about your home?
What kind of home would you like to live in in the future?
Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you find difficult about your work or studies?
What would you like to do in the future?
Do you have a large family?
Who are you closest to in your family?
What do you usually do with your family?
Do you think families spend enough time together nowadays?
Do you spend much time with your friends?
What do you usually do together?
What qualities do you value in a friend?
Do you prefer having a few close friends or many friends?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Do you have enough free time?
Do you prefer spending free time alone or with other people?
Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
Do you have any hobbies?
How did you become interested in your hobby?
How often do you spend time on it?
Is there a hobby you would like to try in the future?
Do you often listen to music?

What types of programmes do you enjoy?

What kind of food do you enjoy eating?

Do you enjoy trying food from other countries?
Do you like cooking?
How often do you cook?
Who usually cooks in your home?
What dish would you like to learn to cook well?
What kind of weather do you like most?
What is the weather usually like where you live?
Does the weather affect your mood?
Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?
What is your favourite season?
What do you usually do during that season?
Are the seasons very different where you live?
Has your favourite season changed since childhood?
Do you enjoy travelling?
How often do you travel?
What kind of places do you like visiting?
Do you prefer travelling alone or with other people?
How do you usually get around your city?

Do you prefer comfortable or fashionable clothes?
Do you enjoy buying new clothes?

What sports are popular in your country?

What makes it difficult for people to exercise regularly?

Which device is most useful to you?

Is there any technology you would like to use less?
How often do you use your mobile phone?
What do you mainly use your phone for?
Could you live without your phone for a day?
Do you think people use mobile phones too much?
Do you use social media?
What do you usually use it for?

Has social media changed the way you keep in touch with people?
